run_decomposed_errors: run decomposed_errors to classify bridge question retrieval errors into start errors, bridge errors, and failures
run_collect_gold_decomposition: run collect_gold_decomposition to interactively collect and annotate sub-questions for bridge-type QDMR samples
run_qdmr_utils: run qdmr_utils to convert collected QDMR inspection data into end-to-end multi-hop retrieval format
run_analyze_results: run analyze_results to compare decomposed versus end-to-end retrieval results and count better, worse, and both cases
review_decomposed_analysis: review the decomposed_analysis module for error classification, data collection, format conversion, and result comparison utilities
